corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from cassandra.cluster import Session
import asyncio

router = APIRouter(prefix="/collab/documents")

@router.get("/{doc_id}/revisions/{rev_id}")
async def get_document_revision(
    doc_id: str,
    rev_id: int,
    session: Session = Depends(get_scylladb_session),
    author: AuthorUser = Depends(get_author_user),
    doc_svc: DocumentService = Depends(get_document_service)
):
    doc = await doc_svc.get_document_metadata(doc_id)
    if not doc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Document not found")
    if doc.workspace_id not in author.workspace_ids and not author.is_site_admin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: author does not have access to this document")

    cql = "SELECT revision_id, author_id, diff_delta, commit_message FROM document_revisions WHERE doc_id = %s AND revision_id = %s"
    future = session.execute_async(cql, (doc_id, rev_id))
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    rows = await loop.run_in_executor(None, future.result)
    row = rows.one()
    if not row:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Revision not found")

    return {
        "doc_id": doc_id,
        "rev_id": row.revision_id,
        "author_id": row.author_id,
        "diff": row.diff_delta,
        "commit": row.commit_message
    }
